metadata.notes: Offline actual Generator MIDI, distinct default channels. sounding_percent=union of MIDI note gates, not acoustic energy. enabled_percent=layerPlaying state, not sounding activity. v2.1 has no main melody; those zero values mean unavailable, not a failed role. template_changes counts changes in selected catalog index, not individual chords. Recurrence planned/performed counters are comparable in unchanged Score roles; Pop template changes can switch between phrased and continuous Hook strategies. No Studio One preset was available.
